variations.name: Electric motorcycles (on-road and off-road)
variations.description: Battery-electric motorcycles replace petrol bikes for commuting, sport and off-road riding, eliminating tailpipe emissions and noise — but high prices and limited highway range have kept Western consumer demand thin, while India and profitable off-road niches grow.

companies.name: Zero Motorcycles
companies.what: Longest-running dedicated electric motorcycle OEM (US), full street/dual-sport lineup on its Z-Force powertrain
companies.signal: Raised $120M (Oct 2024); sales declined from 3,979 units (2022) to ~1,944 in first 9 months of 2025

companies.name: LiveWire
companies.what: Harley-Davidson's NYSE-listed electric spinoff selling premium S2/Del Mar models
companies.signal: Sold just 33 motorcycles in Q1 2025 (-72% YoY); kept afloat by Harley-Davidson backing, far from profitability

companies.name: Stark Future
companies.what: Barcelona maker of the Varg electric motocross/supermoto bike; vertically integrated and one of the only profitable e-moto OEMs
companies.signal: 2025 revenue ~EUR 115M (+77% YoY) with profitable months (Apr 2025: $20.5M revenue, +$3.1M EBITDA); 400 retail locations in 50+ countries

companies.name: Ultraviolette
companies.what: Bengaluru maker of the F77 high-performance electric motorcycle, expanding from India into Europe and Latin America
companies.signal: ~$75M raised incl. $21M from TDK Ventures (Aug 2025) and $45M Series E led by Zoho/Lingotto; targeting 14 models by early 2027

companies.name: Oben Electric
companies.what: Bengaluru OEM of affordable LFP-battery commuter electric motorcycles (Rorr) built for Indian heat
companies.signal: Total funding ~INR 285 crore after INR 85 Cr pre-Series B (2025)

companies.name: Can-Am (BRP)
companies.what: Powersports giant re-entered motorcycles as electric-only with the Origin and Pulse on its Rotax E-Power platform
companies.signal: First deliveries 2025; one of the few incumbent powersports entries into electric two-wheelers

companies.name: Energica
companies.what: Italian pioneer of high-performance electric sportbikes (Ego, Experia); former MotoE supplier
companies.signal: Filed bankruptcy Oct 2024 under Ideanomics ownership; taken over by Singapore investor group in 2025 with relaunch underway

companies.name: Cake
companies.what: Swedish design-led lightweight e-motorcycles (Kalk, Osa) for urban and off-road use
companies.signal: Filed bankruptcy Feb 2024 and re-emerged under new Norwegian owner (Brages); small-scale relaunch

companies.name: Fuell
companies.what: Erik Buell-founded e-motorcycle/e-bike startup (Fllow motorcycle, Flluid e-bikes)
companies.signal: Went out of business in 2024 leaving crowdfunding backers without products

companies.name: Sondors
companies.what: Crowdfunded budget e-bike maker that attempted the Metacycle low-cost electric motorcycle
companies.signal: Ceased operations/went out of business (2023-24) after Metacycle quality and delivery failures

variations.white_space: Player count is high but financial credibility is thin: Western consumer demand never materialized at premium prices (Energica, Cake, Fuell, Sondors all failed 2023-25) because range/price economics at highway speed favor ICE; the proven openings are profitable performance niches with vertical integration (Stark model) and low-cost commuter bikes in motorcycle-first markets (India, SE Asia, LatAm).

variations.name: Electric scooters & mopeds (seated)
variations.description: Seated electric scooters and mopeds substitute the ~100-125cc petrol scooters that dominate Asian urban transport, offering far lower running costs and near purchase-price parity — the single biggest two-wheeler decarbonization lever globally.

companies.name: Yadea
companies.what: World's largest electric two-wheeler maker (China), spanning lead-acid e-mopeds to lithium scooters at massive scale
companies.signal: 1.85M unit sales in H1 2025 (-3.5% YoY) amid Chinese urban 2W restrictions; multi-year global volume leader

companies.name: TVS Motor
companies.what: Indian 2W giant whose iQube took the CY2025 India e-scooter crown
companies.signal: 298,967 e-scooters sold CY2025 (+35% YoY), ~23% market share — ended Ola's three-year lead

companies.name: Bajaj Auto
companies.what: Maker of the Chetak electric scooter and contract manufacturer for Yulu fleet vehicles
companies.signal: 269,836 units CY2025 (+39% YoY), ~21% India share, #2 position

companies.name: Ather Energy
companies.what: Indian smart-scooter pioneer (450 series, Rizta family scooter) with its own fast-charging grid
companies.signal: IPO'd on Indian bourses 2025; 200,785 units CY2025 (+59%), ~16% share; Rizta is ~70% of sales

companies.name: Ola Electric
companies.what: Vertically integrated Indian e-scooter maker (own gigafactory and cell program) that scaled fastest 2022-24
companies.signal: Sales fell ~51% in CY2025, slipping from #1 to #4 amid quality/service backlash; listed company under margin pressure

companies.name: Gogoro
companies.what: Taiwanese Smartscooter OEM tightly coupled to its battery-swap ecosystem
companies.signal: NASDAQ-listed but distressed: FY2024 net loss ~$123M, Q3 2025 revenue -10.6% YoY, $447M debt vs $132M equity

companies.name: NIU Technologies
companies.what: NASDAQ-listed Chinese maker of connected lithium e-scooters and kick scooters sold in 50+ countries
companies.signal: Consistently ranked among global e-scooter leaders in 2025-2033 market analyses

companies.name: Honda
companies.what: World's largest motorcycle maker electrifying its best-seller: Activa e: with swappable Mobile Power Pack batteries plus QC1 fixed-battery scooter
companies.signal: Activa e: launched India Feb 2025 (from Rs 1.2 lakh); very slow early uptake (tens of units/month mid-2025) as swap network builds out

companies.name: Hero MotoCorp (Vida)
companies.what: World's largest 2W maker by volume scaling its Vida electric scooter sub-brand
companies.signal: Clocked best-ever e-scooter retails in CY2025 (top-5 India e-2W OEM); also invested in Ather and Euler

companies.name: River Mobility
companies.what: Bengaluru maker of the utility-focused Indie scooter; co-developing the RY01 global e-scooter with Yamaha
companies.signal: Yamaha invested $40M Series B (Feb 2024); record 1,518 units in July 2025; RY01 production slated from late 2025

variations.name: Electric three-wheelers & rickshaws (passenger transport)
variations.description: Electric autos and e-rickshaws electrify paratransit and shared last-mile passenger transport in South Asia and Africa, where per-km energy costs far below CNG/petrol translate directly into higher driver income.

companies.name: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility
companies.what: India's e-3W market leader (Treo, Zor, e-Alfa) spanning passenger autos and cargo
companies.signal: Record 10,786 e-3Ws delivered Nov 2025 (+51% YoY), ~13% market share in a 700k+ unit annual market

companies.name: Bajaj Auto
companies.what: World's largest autorickshaw maker electrifying with the GoGo e-rickshaw and RE E-TEC autos
companies.signal: 71,025 e-3W units Jan-Nov 2025, ~10% market share, best-ever monthly sales during 2025

companies.name: YC Electric
companies.what: Largest of India's low-cost e-rickshaw specialists (Yatri), dominating the lead-acid/entry passenger segment
companies.signal: Named alongside Mahindra as a leading player in the global electric 3-wheeler market

companies.name: Piaggio
companies.what: Italian incumbent electrifying the iconic Ape (Ape E-City/Elektrik) for Indian and European markets
companies.signal: Launched battery-subscription model April 2025 cutting Ape Elektrik price to ~INR 2.59 lakh; covers up to 150,000 km over 8 years

companies.name: Euler Motors
companies.what: Delhi startup building lithium-ion cargo and passenger 3Ws (HiLoad) with telematics-validated TCO for e-commerce fleets
companies.signal: Series E INR 4.37B (2025); ~$254M total raised; Hero MotoCorp added up to INR 2.75B (Feb 2026)

companies.name: Omega Seiki Mobility
companies.what: Indian OEM of electric cargo and passenger 3Ws (Rage+, Vicktor) pushing upmarket and into e-trucks
companies.signal: ~$3M raised to date; planning ~$40M raise for electric truck expansion; showcased lineup at Bharat Mobility 2025

companies.name: Montra Electric (TI Clean Mobility)
companies.what: Murugappa Group's EV arm whose Super Auto e-3W has rapidly climbed India's passenger e-auto sales charts
companies.signal: Ranked among India's top-10 e-3W OEMs through 2025 monthly sales tallies

companies.name: Altigreen
companies.what: Bengaluru cargo e-3W maker (neEV) that raised from Reliance New Energy and others
companies.signal: Listed as a key Euler competitor, but little verifiable funding/sales news since 2024 amid reported financial stress

variations.name: Cargo e-bikes & electric delivery trikes/quads
variations.description: Electric cargo bikes and four-wheeled e-quads replace vans for urban parcel and grocery last-mile delivery, cutting emissions, congestion and per-stop cost in dense low-emission-zone cities.

companies.name: Urban Arrow
companies.what: Pon.Bike-owned Dutch leader in family and business front-loader cargo e-bikes (Tender line up to 300 kg payload)
companies.signal: European category leader; business line (Tender 1500) sold into commercial fleets across Europe

companies.name: ONOMOTION
companies.what: Berlin maker of the ONO e-quad with swappable cargo containers, run as vehicle-as-a-service for parcel carriers
companies.signal: Raised EUR 21M (equity+debt, Dec 2022); hundreds of vehicles deployed with UPS, DPD and Hermes in German cities

companies.name: EAV
companies.what: UK builder of the EAVan lightweight delivery quad designed as a direct van substitute
companies.signal: Fleet deals with Evri and FedEx among UK/EU logistics customers

companies.name: Fernhay
companies.what: UK maker of the eQuad walking-pace delivery vehicle used in UPS city-logistics programs
companies.signal: Vehicles deployed across Europe and the US; UPS and the UK Department for Transport among clients; 2025 Zoomo financing/maintenance partnership

companies.name: Vok Bikes
companies.what: Estonian four-wheel cargo e-bike maker with full-suspension fleet-grade vehicles for delivery operators
companies.signal: Partnership with Zoomo (2025) for fleet financing and servicing; growing European fleet deployments

companies.name: Zoomo
companies.what: Australian fleet platform providing e-bikes/cargo quads-as-a-service with maintenance and software to gig and logistics riders
companies.signal: ~$80M raised; partnerships to finance and service Fernhay, Vok and EAV vehicles

companies.name: Babboe (Accell Group)
companies.what: Dutch volume consumer cargo-bike brand
companies.signal: 2024 全-fleet recall after concealed frame failures: Dutch sales ban, 22,000 bikes replaced, criminal investigation; brand future under Accell unclear

variations.white_space: The van-replacement e-quad niche remains thin: hardware is capex-heavy, fleet procurement cycles are slow, and quality failures (Babboe) show the durability bar; the opening is fleet-grade serviceable vehicles bundled with financing/maintenance (the Zoomo-style as-a-service model) rather than one-off hardware sales.

variations.name: E-bikes & e-bike drive systems
variations.description: Pedal-assist e-bikes displace short car trips at among the lowest costs per tonne of CO2 avoided in transport, with a concentrated drive-system layer (motors, batteries, software) supplying hundreds of bike brands.

companies.name: Bosch eBike Systems
companies.what: Dominant premium mid-drive system supplier in Europe with connected ABS/anti-theft ecosystem
companies.signal: Market-leading installed base across hundreds of OEM bike brands; consistently rated most trusted drive supplier

companies.name: Bafang
companies.what: Largest Chinese e-bike motor maker supplying hub and mid-drives across all price points worldwide
companies.signal: One of the highest-volume drive suppliers globally; standard choice for value e-bike brands

companies.name: Shimano
companies.what: Bicycle components giant supplying STEPS/EP-series mid-drive systems integrated with its drivetrains
companies.signal: Among the top global e-bike drive suppliers alongside Bosch and Bafang

companies.name: DJI (Avinox)
companies.what: Drone giant's e-bike drive unit whose high-power Avinox motor is rapidly winning premium eMTB design slots
companies.signal: 16 OEM partnerships announced at Eurobike 2025; 12+ bike brands shipping Avinox-equipped models

companies.name: Specialized
companies.what: Major bike maker with the vertically developed Turbo e-bike range (Vado, Levo) and in-house motor tuning
companies.signal: Among the most established premium e-bike lines globally

companies.name: Lectric eBikes
companies.what: Bootstrapped Phoenix D2C brand selling sub-$1,500 folding e-bikes; profitable while VC-backed rivals collapsed
companies.signal: Record sales month in 2025 as competitors went bankrupt; among top US e-bike sellers by unit volume

companies.name: Rad Power Bikes
companies.what: Formerly North America's #1 e-bike brand (once valued >$1B) selling value utility e-bikes D2C
companies.signal: Filed Chapter 11 on Dec 15, 2025 with $32M assets vs $73M liabilities, seeking a buyer after years of layoffs

companies.name: VanMoof
companies.what: Dutch designer of fully integrated 'smartphone-on-wheels' city e-bikes sold D2C
companies.signal: Bankrupt July 2023 after burning >$200M; acquired by Lavoie (McLaren Applied) which shifted to third-party service networks

companies.name: Cowboy
companies.what: Belgian connected city e-bike brand known for app-first design
companies.signal: After prolonged financial distress, acquired in Dec 2025 by French micromobility group ReBirth; production restarting in France in 2026

variations.name: Shared micromobility fleet operators
variations.description: App-rented shared e-scooter and e-bike fleets substitute short car and ride-hail trips and extend transit reach; after a brutal 2023-25 consolidation, the surviving operators run profitably at city scale.

companies.name: Lime
companies.what: Global shared e-scooter/e-bike leader (~27% share across its countries, 37% in the US)
companies.signal: 2024 net revenue $686M (+32%) with >$140M adj. EBITDA; filed for Nasdaq IPO disclosing ~$860M annual revenue and ~$846M near-term debt

companies.name: Voi
companies.what: Swedish operator focused on tender-won European city contracts
companies.signal: Record Q3 2025: net revenue EUR 57.5M (+34% YoY), strongest-ever operating cash flow EUR 19.8M

companies.name: Dott (merged with TIER)
companies.what: Combined Dott-TIER entity operating shared scooters/bikes across ~400 European cities under the Dott brand
companies.signal: Merged March 2024; adjusted-EBITDA profitable post-merger; raised EUR 85M to consolidate

companies.name: Neuron Mobility Holdings (Beam + Neuron)
companies.what: Singapore-based APAC leader formed by the Beam-Neuron merger, strongest in Australia, Korea, SE Asia, Canada, Turkey
companies.signal: Merger completed Sept 22, 2025; ~100,000 e-scooters across 100+ cities

companies.name: Bird
companies.what: US scooter-sharing pioneer that overexpanded, went bankrupt, and now operates leaner under Third Lane Mobility
companies.signal: Chapter 11 in Dec 2023 after NYSE delisting; assets acquired and restructured by Third Lane Mobility

companies.name: Superpedestrian
companies.what: MIT-spinoff operator of the LINK scooter with onboard safety/geofencing computing
companies.signal: Shut down US operations and wound down in Dec 2023 after failing to find a buyer

companies.name: Bolt
companies.what: Estonian ride-hailing super-app cross-subsidizing one of Europe's largest scooter/e-bike fleets
companies.signal: Among Europe's top micromobility operators by fleet size, bundled with ride-hail and delivery

companies.name: Lyft Urban Solutions (Citi Bike)
companies.what: Operator of major docked bikeshare systems including Citi Bike NYC, the largest in North America
companies.signal: Docked systems remain the highest-ridership shared micromobility in US cities

companies.name: Yulu
companies.what: Indian shared e-bike operator focused on gig-delivery riders, with vehicles manufactured by Bajaj Auto
companies.signal: Bajaj-backed; fleet vehicles counted within Bajaj's record CY2025 e-2W output

variations.name: Two-wheeler electric conversion & retrofit kits
variations.description: Type-approved retrofit kits convert existing petrol scooters/motorcycles (and ordinary bicycles) to electric drive at a fraction of new-vehicle cost, decarbonizing the installed fleet instead of waiting for replacement cycles.

companies.name: GoGoA1
companies.what: Thane-based maker of India's first RTO-approved electric conversion kits for petrol motorcycles and scooters (50+ models incl. Hero Splendor, Honda Activa)
companies.signal: ARAI-approved kits from ~INR 35,000 (to ~INR 95,000 with battery); installation network across 36 RTOs

companies.name: Swytch
companies.what: UK maker of compact wheel-swap kits that convert any pedal bicycle into an e-bike
companies.signal: 80,000+ bikes converted worldwide; claims 1 in 14 new UK e-bikes is a Swytch conversion; MAX+ kit rolled out 2025

companies.name: Skarper
companies.what: London startup with a clip-on DiskDrive e-bike conversion system mounting to the disc brake in seconds
companies.signal: Shipping since 2024; featured among 2025 best conversion kits

variations.white_space: Genuinely sparse: per-model homologation (RTO/ARAI type approval) is slow and expensive, kit-plus-battery cost approaches a cheap used EV, and liability/battery certification scares installers — so only a handful of credible players exist; the opening is B2B fleet retrofits (delivery fleets, boda-boda cooperatives, municipal fleets) where one approved model covers thousands of identical vehicles and TCO math is decisive.

variations.name: Emerging-market electric moto-taxis (Africa & SE Asia commercial two-wheelers)
variations.description: Purpose-built, locally assembled electric motorcycles bundled with rider financing and energy services electrify commercial moto-taxi and delivery fleets in Africa and Southeast Asia, where 100+ km/day duty cycles make fuel savings pay back within months.

companies.name: Spiro
companies.what: Africa's largest e-motorcycle OEM-operator (Benin, Togo, Rwanda, Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria+), pairing its own bikes with rider financing
companies.signal: Raised $100M (Oct 2025) — the largest-ever African e-mobility investment; millions of battery swaps completed

companies.name: Ampersand
companies.what: Rwanda/Kenya pioneer building e-motorcycles with AI-optimized battery and energy service for boda-boda riders
companies.signal: Raised ~$7M (late 2025) to grow fleet to 13,000 motorcycles by end-2026

companies.name: Roam (ex-Opibus)
companies.what: Swedish-Kenyan OEM locally designing and manufacturing the Roam Air e-motorcycle in Nairobi with boda-boda rider input
companies.signal: Opened Kenya's first fast-charging network for light EVs (Roam Point, Nov 2025)

companies.name: Zembo
companies.what: Uganda operator bundling e-boda motorcycles with solar-integrated swap stations and pay-as-you-go financing
companies.signal: Operating swap network across Kampala with solar-hybrid stations

companies.name: MAX (Metro Africa Xpress)
companies.what: Nigerian mobility platform financing and deploying electric two/three-wheelers to commercial drivers
companies.signal: Among Africa's most-funded e-mobility players, expanding battery-swap-backed fleets across Nigerian cities

companies.name: Dodai
companies.what: Ethiopia-based assembler of affordable electric motorcycles scaling rapidly in Addis Ababa's delivery market
companies.signal: Cited among the leading two-wheeler players in Africa's 2025 e-mobility boom analyses

variations.white_space: Few players have scaled beyond one country because the model is triple-capital-intensive (vehicles + energy infrastructure + rider credit) in weak-currency markets; the opening is OEM partnerships with dedicated financiers/energy providers and pan-African battery standardization rather than fully vertically integrated plays.

variations.name: Standing e-kickscooters & personal light EV OEMs
variations.description: Standing electric kickscooters and related personal light EVs from consumer-electronics-scale OEMs provide cheap first/last-mile transport and supply the ruggedized hardware behind shared fleets worldwide.

companies.name: Segway-Ninebot
companies.what: World's #1 electric kickscooter maker, supplying both consumers and most major shared operators
companies.signal: Powers millions of shared vehicles across 47+ countries via its B2B division

companies.name: Okai
companies.what: Chinese OEM specializing in fleet-grade scooters/e-bikes with IoT and swappable batteries for sharing operators
companies.signal: Long-time hardware supplier to major Western scooter-share fleets (e.g., ES400 fleet platform)

companies.name: Xiaomi
companies.what: Consumer electronics giant selling mass-market folding e-scooters at electronics-retail price points
companies.signal: Consistently ranked among the top global micromobility hardware companies

variations.white_space: Consumer kickscooter manufacturing is locked up by Chinese electronics-scale incumbents competing on price, leaving little room for hardware startups; remaining openings are regulatory-compliance niches (UL 2272-certified batteries, EU type approval) and durable fleet-spec hardware with repairability guarantees.
